final: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT k, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM c) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_number, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(n - av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE n > av
